title: Any gamers here?
content: Im not sure if it's just my real life bleeding in because I play a lot of video games irl, but the other day I was in mallworld and I saw an information desk and went up to it. There was a very tall man in a suit, and I asked him what exactly mallworld was, he looked at me very wide-eyed and said "It's a game". And then I woke up. Ever since then I've been thinking how mallworld could be a game. It would definitely be an open world, sandbox, simulation, choose your own adventure, single player, or mmo. Each dream is it's own lobby or server. Sometimes you're in a private lobby, and sometimes public. And now that I think about it, i do dream a lot in 3rd person. I think the shared loading areas, are the places a lot of us frequently talk about in mallworld. The airport, the Waterpark, the red hotel, the bathrooms, etc. I think we go there in between dreams. I think the dream police could be npcs in the game trying to keep us on track of our mission, whatever that is. Idk this is just my theory now. When I look at everything through gaming eyes, it all makes sense.
